recorded.outcome:q-flag-cache:a: Code `now.isBefore(e.touched().plus(ttl))` measures the TTL from the stored time, and the page: "the five minutes count from the last read, not from the load"; the FAILED run shows the old price kept past the limit
recorded.prompt:q-flag-cache:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flag-cache:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-flag-cache:c: `entries.put(sku, new Entry(e.price(), now))` replaces the entry's single time; "Each hit writes `now` back into the entry, so the five minutes count from the last read, not from the load"
recorded.prompt:q-flag-cache:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flag-cache:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-flag-cache:d: Outcome is right but the reason is refuted by the code: `price()` checks `now.isBefore(e.touched().plus(ttl))` on every call, and the page puts the cause on the hit writing `now` back ("so the five minutes count from the last read"). The refutation comes from the code shown, not from a sentence that says it outright.

recorded.pass:q-session-dump:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-session-dump:a: The report loop with only two entries (well below any resize) throws ConcurrentModificationException, which the page attributes to `get` moving the entry. So the outcome 'prints all' is refuted. The rehash reason is refuted only by inference: the page says nowhere in so many words that get never rehashes.

The rehash reason is refuted only by inference: the page never says get does not rehash.
